title: First login
brief: Halcyon Corp hired you for a security test. Your account on the laptop is guest. Look around, read what is there, and find the flag.
hint.1: Type ls to list files, and cat <file> to read one.
hint.2: Hidden files start with a dot. ls -a shows them.
hint.3: cd .hidden, then cat flag.txt. Finish with: submit <flag>.
walkthrough: ls, cat readme.txt, ls -a, cd .hidden, cat flag.txt, then submit the flag.
debrief: A shell is just a way to ask the computer questions. ls, cd and cat are enough to explore any Linux machine. Dot files are not secret, only hidden from the default view. Defenders: never rely on hidden file names to protect data.
objective.list: List the files in your home folder
objective.found: Find and read the hidden flag file
